aboutMe.title: About Me
aboutMe.text: I'm a Computer Engineer and Full Stack Developer with over 4 years of experience creating web applications, enterprise solutions, and professional websites. Throughout my journey, I have collaborated with companies across different industries, delivering scalable and user-focused solutions while working on both frontend and backend development in agile teams. I have hands-on experience with technologies such as C#, ASP.NET, Blazor, Angular, React, JavaScript, Node.js, and WordPress, allowing me to build complete digital products from concept to deployment. Currently, I work at Capgemini, where I contribute to high-impact projects for leading financial clients, helping transform business requirements into reliable and innovative software solutions. Passionate about technology and continuous learning, I strive to create digital experiences that combine performance, usability, and business value.

skills.title: Technologies & Tools
skills.subtitle: Technologies and tools I use to build modern, scalable, and user-centered applications.

cards.title: Full Stack Developer
items: Working on the development of enterprise applications using C#, ASP.NET, and Blazor, participating in all stages of the software development lifecycle, from feature implementation to system maintenance and continuous improvement.
Key Responsibilities:
• Developing full stack solutions for internal projects and large-scale clients.
• Contributing to strategic projects for clients in the financial services sector.
• Transforming business requirements and prototypes into modern, intuitive user interfaces.
• Developing and integrating backend functionalities.
• Utilizing Azure DevOps and Jira for task management, source control, and CI/CD pipelines.
• Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams in agile development environments.

cards.title: Software Developer
items: Developed web applications, corporate websites, and customized digital solutions, actively contributing to both software development and business requirements analysis.
Key Responsibilities:
• Developing responsive and interactive user interfaces with React.js, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
• Building and maintaining WordPress websites tailored to client needs.
• Developing backend services using Node.js, MongoDB, and MySQL.
• Designing conversational workflows through Zenvia Flow.
• Gathering requirements and producing documentation for educational technology projects.
• Working within Scrum-based agile teams, contributing to planning, development, and successful project delivery.

cards.title: Front-end Developer
cards.company: STTP - Superintendency of Traffic and Public Transportation
items: Contributed to the development and maintenance of internal systems and web applications that supported administrative operations and digital services.
Key Responsibilities:
• Developing responsive and user-friendly interfaces with Angular, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap.
• Supporting backend development using Node.js and MongoDB.
• Maintaining and improving legacy applications built with PHP.
• Managing source code and collaboration workflows through Git.
• Building and maintaining CRUD applications and institutional web portals.

portfolio.title: Featured Projects
portfolio.subtitle: In addition to my experience in corporate environments and enterprise projects, I design and develop custom websites for businesses and professionals across a wide range of industries.Leveraging WordPress, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, I build modern, responsive, and user-focused websites that align with each client's goals. My approach combines clean design, performance, and usability to deliver impactful digital experiences.
